   - `gui/.next/` と `gui/.next/cache/`
   - `release-package/codex.exe`
2. `git gc --prune=now --aggressive` でリポジトリを最適化
3. マージコミットを完了

**注意点：**
pre-commitフックが大きなファイル（50MB以上）を検出していますが、これらは警告のみでコミットは成功しています。これらは既にgitに追加されている可能性があります。完全に削除する場合は、以下を実行してください：

```powershell
git rm -r --cached codex-rs/target/debug/ codex-rs/target_locked_backup/ gui/.next/cache/ release-package/codex.exe
git commit -m "Remove large build artifacts from git tracking"
```

今後は `.gitignore` により、これらのファイルは自動的に無視されます。

**次のステップ：**
残りの変更（`.specstory` のファイルや `codex-rs/core/src/llmops.rs` など）をコミットできます。

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\公式リポジトリとの整合性管理.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 71
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリとの整合性管理ガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-10-23  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI/codex公式リポジトリとの整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持  ",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**戦略**: Fork + Enhancement（フォーク＋拡張）モデル",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔄 整合性戦略",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Upstream同期ポリシー",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 定期同期",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "# 月1回: 公式リポジトリの最新変更を取得",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "git merge upstream/main --strategy-option theirs",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 選択的マージ",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **✅ 取り込む**: バグ修正、セキュリティアップデート、コア機能改善",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **❌ 取り込まない**: zapabob独自機能と競合する変更",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. ブランチ戦略",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "main (zapabob独自 + 公式統合)",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "├── upstream-sync (公式リポジトリ同期用)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "├── feature/zapabob-* (独自機能開発)",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "└── hotfix/* (緊急修正)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 独自性維持項目",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 🔌 Gemini CLI MCP統合",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- OAuth 2.0認証（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- Google Search Grounding統合",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- 自動フォールバック: gemini-2.5-pro → gemini-2.5-flash",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP（Model Context Protocol）サーバー実装",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 公式との差分",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "// zapabob独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "codex-rs/",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "├── gemini-cli-mcp-server/  // 独自: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── src/",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "│   │   └── main.rs",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── Cargo.toml",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "└── deep-research/           // 拡張: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── src/",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        ├── gemini_search_provider.rs  // 独自",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        └── web_search_provider.rs     // 拡張",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 🔔 Marisa音声通知システム",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- タスク完了時の音声通知",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Marisaキャラクター音声",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- Windows/macOS/Linux対応",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 統合ポイント",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "# config.toml",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "[hooks]",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "on_task_complete = \"powershell -File zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1\"",
            "lineNumber": 71
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.39943990111351013
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\2025-10-07_公式リポジトリ統合.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 66
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリ統合作業ログ",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025年10月7日 23:25 JST  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI公式Codexリポジトリとの統合を行い、独自機能を尊重しつつ最新版と連携",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "ローカルにダウンロードしたCodexプロジェクトを、公式GitHubリポジトリと統合し、独自機能を保護しつつ最新の更新を取り込める体制を構築したで！",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 実施した作業",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Git リポジトリの初期化",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git init",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- ローカルディレクトリをGitリポジトリとして初期化",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- 空のリポジトリから開始",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 公式リポジトリの追加",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add origin https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;upstream&#96;: 公式リポジトリへの参照",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;origin&#96;: 同じく公式リポジトリ（標準的な命名規則に従う）",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. 公式リポジトリの取得",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- 公式リポジトリから全ブランチとタグを取得",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- 300以上のブランチが存在することを確認",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- 最新のタグ: &#96;rust-v0.45.0&#96;, &#96;rust-v0.2.0-alpha.2&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. ローカル状態の保存",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "git add .",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "git commit -m \"Initial commit: Local Codex files\"",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- 1079ファイルをコミット",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- 177,647行の追加を記録",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- コミットハッシュ: &#96;ccfc74e0&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5. 独自機能の保護",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "git checkout -b feature/local-custom-features",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "- 独自機能を保存する専用ブランチを作成",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;.specstory/&#96; ディレクトリを含むローカルカスタマイズを保護",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 差分分析",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "### 主な違い",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "公式リポジトリ(&#96;upstream/main&#96;)との差分:",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "- **291ファイル**に変更あり",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **+7,253行** 追加",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "- **-16,431行** 削除",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "### 独自機能",

          },
          {

        "detailedLines": [

          {

          {
            "text": "### 1. 現在の設定確認",

          },
          {
            "text": "**リモートリポジトリ設定:**",

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

            "lineNumber": 16

          {

            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "upstream  https://github.com/openai/codex.git (push)",

          {

            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "**現在のブランチ:**",

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;main&#96; ブランチ（✅ 正しく設定済み）",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "**同期状態:**",

          },

          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 実施した修正作業",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### 問題発見",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "初回の &#96;git fetch origin&#96; でリモート参照のロックエラーが発生：",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "error: cannot lock ref 'refs/remotes/origin/main': ",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  is at a06d4f5bef72de68a5b5f7a80dfe02b034574c6c ",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  but expected ebe706b37de2c5d6d8be7c34f46bab4abe2682ae",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### 解決策",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "# リモート参照を正しい値に更新",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main a06d4f5bef72de68a5b5f7a80dfe02b034574c6c",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "# 最新の変更をpull",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "git pull origin main",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "# =&gt; Already up to date.",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "## ✅ 最終確認結果",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "### リポジトリ構成",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Origin**: &#96;zapabob/codex&#96; (フォーク先・メインリポジトリ)",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Upstream**: &#96;openai/codex&#96; (公式リポジトリ)",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\implementation-logs\\公式リポジトリとの整合性管理.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 71
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリとの整合性管理ガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-10-23  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI/codex公式リポジトリとの整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持  ",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**戦略**: Fork + Enhancement（フォーク＋拡張）モデル",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔄 整合性戦略",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Upstream同期ポリシー",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 定期同期",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "# 月1回: 公式リポジトリの最新変更を取得",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "git merge upstream/main --strategy-option theirs",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 選択的マージ",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **✅ 取り込む**: バグ修正、セキュリティアップデート、コア機能改善",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **❌ 取り込まない**: zapabob独自機能と競合する変更",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. ブランチ戦略",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "main (zapabob独自 + 公式統合)",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "├── upstream-sync (公式リポジトリ同期用)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "├── feature/zapabob-* (独自機能開発)",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "└── hotfix/* (緊急修正)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 独自性維持項目",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 🔌 Gemini CLI MCP統合",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- OAuth 2.0認証（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- Google Search Grounding統合",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- 自動フォールバック: gemini-2.5-pro → gemini-2.5-flash",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP（Model Context Protocol）サーバー実装",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 公式との差分",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "// zapabob独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "codex-rs/",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "├── gemini-cli-mcp-server/  // 独自: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── src/",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "│   │   └── main.rs",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── Cargo.toml",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "└── deep-research/           // 拡張: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── src/",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        ├── gemini_search_provider.rs  // 独自",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        └── web_search_provider.rs     // 拡張",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 🔔 Marisa音声通知システム",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- タスク完了時の音声通知",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Marisaキャラクター音声",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- Windows/macOS/Linux対応",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 統合ポイント",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "# config.toml",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "[hooks]",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "on_task_complete = \"powershell -File zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1\"",
            "lineNumber": 71
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3852444887161255
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\repository-relationship.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 64
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 139
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "| **openai/codex** | main | 9a10e80ab | 数千+ |",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "| **zapabob/codex** | main | 2a3ddfd0c | 3 |",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "**差分**: zapabobは公式から分岐した独自実装を含む",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 同期方法",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 公式から最新を取得",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリから最新情報を取得",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "# 現在の状態を確認",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "git log --oneline --graph --decorate --all --max-count=20",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 公式の変更をマージ",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "# upstream/mainの変更をローカルmainにマージ",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "git merge upstream/main",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "# コンフリクトが発生した場合は解決",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "git mergetool",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "# マージ完了後コミット",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "git commit",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. zapabobリポジトリへプッシュ",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "# originにプッシュ",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "git push origin main",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚠️ 注意事項",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "### マージ時のコンフリクト可能性",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "zapabob/codexは独自拡張を多数含むため、以下のファイルでコンフリクトが発生する可能性：",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/core/&#96; - コアオーケストレーション機能",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/cli/&#96; - CLI拡張",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;.codex/agents/&#96; - サブエージェント定義",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;docs/&#96; - ドキュメント",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;kernel-extensions/&#96; - Windowsカーネルドライバー（公式には存在しない）",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "**推奨**: ",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "1. マージ前にバックアップブランチ作成",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 段階的マージ（ファイル単位）",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "3. 独自機能は別ブランチで管理",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "---",

          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 概要",

          {
            "text": "OpenAI公式リポジトリ（upstream）と整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持するための大規模マージ作業を実施。",

          {

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "if (Test-Path \"$backupDir/.zapabob-files\") {",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "    Get-Content \"$backupDir/.zapabob-files\" | ForEach-Object {",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "        $line = $_.Trim()",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "        if ($line -and -not $line.StartsWith(\"#\")) {",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "            $sourcePath = Join-Path $backupDir $line",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "            if (Test-Path $sourcePath) {",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "                Write-Host \"  ✅ 復元: $line\" -ForegroundColor Green",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "                $destDir = Split-Path $line -Parent",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "                if ($destDir -and -not (Test-Path $destDir)) {",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destDir -Force | Out-Null",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "                }",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "                Copy-Item -Path $sourcePath -Destination $line -Recurse -Force",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"&#96;n✅ 復元完了&#96;n\" -ForegroundColor Green",

          },

            "lineNumber": 92

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\implementation-logs\\2025-10-07_公式リポジトリ統合.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 66
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリ統合作業ログ",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025年10月7日 23:25 JST  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI公式Codexリポジトリとの統合を行い、独自機能を尊重しつつ最新版と連携",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "ローカルにダウンロードしたCodexプロジェクトを、公式GitHubリポジトリと統合し、独自機能を保護しつつ最新の更新を取り込める体制を構築したで！",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 実施した作業",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Git リポジトリの初期化",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git init",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- ローカルディレクトリをGitリポジトリとして初期化",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- 空のリポジトリから開始",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 公式リポジトリの追加",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add origin https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;upstream&#96;: 公式リポジトリへの参照",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;origin&#96;: 同じく公式リポジトリ（標準的な命名規則に従う）",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. 公式リポジトリの取得",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- 公式リポジトリから全ブランチとタグを取得",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- 300以上のブランチが存在することを確認",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- 最新のタグ: &#96;rust-v0.45.0&#96;, &#96;rust-v0.2.0-alpha.2&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. ローカル状態の保存",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "git add .",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "git commit -m \"Initial commit: Local Codex files\"",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- 1079ファイルをコミット",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- 177,647行の追加を記録",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- コミットハッシュ: &#96;ccfc74e0&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5. 独自機能の保護",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "git checkout -b feature/local-custom-features",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "- 独自機能を保存する専用ブランチを作成",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;.specstory/&#96; ディレクトリを含むローカルカスタマイズを保護",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 差分分析",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "### 主な違い",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "公式リポジトリ(&#96;upstream/main&#96;)との差分:",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "- **291ファイル**に変更あり",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "- **+7,253行** 追加",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "- **-16,431行** 削除",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "### 独自機能",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "以下のローカル独自機能を確認:",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;.specstory/&#96; ディレクトリ**",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 実装ログ管理システム",
            "lineNumber": 66
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.37935489416122437
    },

          {
            "text": "    async fn run_agent(",

            "text": "        match task.agent {",

          {
            "text": "            AgentType::Codex =&gt; Self::run_codex(task, Arc::clone(&amp;states), worktree).await,",
            "lineNumber": 250

          {
            "text": "            AgentType::GeminiCLI =&gt; Self::run_gemini(task, Arc::clone(&amp;states), worktree).await,",

          {
            "text": "            AgentType::Claudecode =&gt; Self::run_claude(task, Arc::clone(&amp;states), worktree).await,",

          },

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    async fn run_codex(",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "        task: &amp;AgentTask,",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          {
            "text": "    ) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {",

          },

          {
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "        let default_path = PathBuf::from(\".\");",

          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\exec\\src\\main.rs",
        "range": {

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Entry-point for the &#96;codex-exec&#96; binary.",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! When this CLI is invoked normally, it parses the standard &#96;codex-exec&#96; CLI",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! options and launches the non-interactive Codex agent. However, if it is",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! invoked with arg0 as &#96;codex-linux-sandbox&#96;, we instead treat the invocation",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! as a request to run the logic for the standalone &#96;codex-linux-sandbox&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! executable (i.e., parse any -s args and then run a *sandboxed* command under",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Landlock + seccomp.",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This allows us to ship a completely separate set of functionality as part",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//! of the &#96;codex-exec&#96; binary.",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "use clap::Parser;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_arg0::arg0_dispatch_or_else;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_common::CliConfigOverrides;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_exec::Cli;",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_exec::run_main;",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Parser, Debug)]",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "struct TopCli {",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    #[clap(flatten)]",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    config_overrides: CliConfigOverrides,",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    #[clap(flatten)]",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    inner: Cli,",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "fn main() -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    arg0_dispatch_or_else(|codex_linux_sandbox_exe| async move {",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "        let top_cli = TopCli::parse();",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Merge root-level overrides into inner CLI struct so downstream logic remains unchanged.",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut inner = top_cli.inner;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "        inner",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "            .config_overrides",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "            .raw_overrides",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "            .splice(0..0, top_cli.config_overrides.raw_overrides);",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "        run_main(inner, codex_linux_sandbox_exe).await?;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok(())",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "    })",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 40
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.39732205867767334
    },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\guides\\cursor-integration.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 96,
            "column": 4
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Cursor IDE Integration Guide - zapabob/codex",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**バージョン**: 0.47.0-alpha.1  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**最終更新**: 2025年10月10日",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "zapabob/codexをCursor IDEで使用するための完全なガイドや！  ",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "MCPサーバー経由でサブエージェント、カスタムコマンド、Hookシステムが使えるで〜💪",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📦 インストール",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Codexをグローバルインストール",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "# 既にインストール済みの場合はスキップ",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install -g @openai/codex",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "# または",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": ".\\global-install.ps1  # Windows PowerShell",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 動作確認",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --version",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "# =&gt; codex-cli 0.0.0",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "codex mcp-server --help",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "# =&gt; MCPサーバーのヘルプ表示",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚙️ Cursor設定",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "### 設定ファイル: &#96;.cursor/mcp.json&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "{",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"mcpServers\": {",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"codex\": {",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"command\": \"codex\",",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"env\": {},",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"description\": \"Codex MCP Server with SubAgent, CustomCommand, and Hook support\",",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "      \"disabled\": false",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "### Cursorの再起動",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "設定ファイルを作成したら、**Cursorを再起動**してや！",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🛠️ 利用可能なツール（7個）",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. &#96;codex&#96; - 基本的なCodex呼び出し",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "// 使用例",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "{",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"tool\": \"codex\",",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"arguments\": {",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"prompt\": \"Implement a binary search function in Rust\"",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "const Git4DScene: React.FC&lt;Git4DSceneProps&gt; = ({ mode, isPlaying, handTrackingEnabled }) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "  const { scene, camera } = useThree();",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "  const groupRef = useRef&lt;THREE.Group&gt;(null);",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Mock Git commit data - replace with real data from Rust backend",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "  const commits = React.useMemo(() =&gt; generateMockGit4DCommits(), []);",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Initialize scene",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "  useEffect(() =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Set scene background based on mode",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (mode === 'vr' || mode === 'ar') {",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x000000);",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a0a);",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Add lighting",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, mode === 'ar' ? 0.8 : 0.4);",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "    scene.add(ambientLight);",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "    const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, mode === 'ar' ? 1.0 : 0.8);",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "    directionalLight.position.set(10, 10, 5);",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "    directionalLight.castShadow = mode === 'desktop';",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "    scene.add(directionalLight);",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "    return () =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "      // Cleanup",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.remove(ambientLight);",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.remove(directionalLight);",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "  }, [scene, mode]);",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Animation frame",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "  useFrame((state) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (isPlaying &amp;&amp; groupRef.current) {",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "      // Rotate the entire commit visualization",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "      groupRef.current.rotation.y += 0.005;",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (mode === 'vr' || mode === 'ar') {",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "      // Adjust camera for XR modes",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "      camera.position.z = 3;",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "  });",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "text": "  return (",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "    &lt;&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "      {/* Camera controls for desktop mode */}",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": ";",
            "lineNumber": 377
          }
        ]
      },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 378
          },

            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {

          {

            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": " */",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "export const Git4DWebXRFramework: React.FC = () =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "  const mountRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [xrManager] = useState(() =&gt; new WebXRManager());",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [xrSupported, setXrSupported] = useState&lt;boolean | null&gt;(null);",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [vrSupported, setVrSupported] = useState(false);",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [arSupported, setArSupported] = useState(false);",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [currentMode, setCurrentMode] = useState&lt;'desktop' | 'vr' | 'ar'&gt;('desktop');",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [isInitialized, setIsInitialized] = useState(false);",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [handTrackingEnabled, setHandTrackingEnabled] = useState(false);",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Initialize XR support check",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  useEffect",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": ";",
            "lineNumber": 291
          }
        ]
      },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "export const Git4DVisualization: React.FC = ",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  useEffect(() =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (!mountRef.current) return;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Initialize Three.js scene",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    const scene = new THREE.Scene();",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a0a);",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "    sceneRef.current = scene;",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "      75,",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "      mountRef.current.clientWidth / mountRef.current.clientHeight,",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "      0.1,",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "      1000",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "    );",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "    camera.position.set(0, 0, 5);",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "    cameraRef.current = camera;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    renderer.setSize(mountRef.current.clientWidth, mountRef.current.clientHeight);",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "    rendererRef.current = renderer;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "    mountRef.current.appendChild(renderer.domElement);",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Add lighting",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.4);",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "    scene.add(ambientLight);",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "    const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "    directionalLight.position.set(10, 10, 5);",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "    directionalLight.castShadow = true;",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "    scene.add(directionalLight);",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Create commit visualization",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "    createCommitVisualization(scene, commits);",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Animation loop",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "    const animate = () =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate);",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "      if (isPlaying) {",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Rotate camera for dynamic view",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "        camera.position.x = Math.cos(Date.now() * 0.001 * timeScale) * 8;",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "        camera.position.z = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.001 * timeScale) * 8;",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "      }",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "      renderer.render(scene, camera);",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "    animate();",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Handle resize",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "    const handleResize = () =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "      if (!mountRef.current) return;",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "      camera.aspect = mountRef.current.clientWidth / mountRef.current.clientHeight;",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "      renderer.setSize(mountRef.current.clientWidth, mountRef.current.clientHeight);",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": ";",
            "lineNumber": 321
          }
        ]

          },

            "text": "pub enum AgentType {",

          {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "(",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "        &amp;self,",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "        code_samples: &amp;[String],",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "        analysis_types: &amp;[AgentType],",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "        max_concurrent: usize,",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "    ) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;ParallelExecutionResult&gt;, String&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut tasks = Vec::new();",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut results = Vec::new();",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Submit tasks for each code sample and analysis type",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "        for (sample_idx, code) in code_samples.iter().enumerate() {",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "            for (type_idx, &amp;analysis_type) in analysis_types.iter().enumerate() {",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "                let task_id = format!(",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "                    \"qc_analysis_{}_{}_{}\",",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "                    sample_idx,",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "                    type_idx,",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "                    chrono::Utc::now().timestamp()",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "                );",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "                let payload = serde_json::json!({",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "                    \"code\": code,",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "                    \"analysis_type\": analysis_type,",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "                    \"sample_index\": sample_idx",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "                });",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "                match self",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "                    .submit_task(",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "                        task_id.clone(),",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "                        analysis_type,",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "                        TaskPriority::Medium,",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "                        payload,",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "                        Some(30000), // 30 second timeout",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "                    )",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "                    .await",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "                {",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "                    Ok(_) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "                        tasks.push(task_id);",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "                    }",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "                    Err(e) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "                        println!(\"⚠️  Failed to submit task: {e}\");",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "                    }",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "                }",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Wait for results with concurrency control",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut active_tasks = 0;",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut task_iter = tasks.into_iter();",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "        while active_tasks &gt; 0 || task_iter.size_hint().0 &gt; 0",
            "lineNumber": 252
          }
        ]
      },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Sub-Agents System",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status**: Stable | **Version**: 2.8.3",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "並列AIエージェントによるタスク分割実行システム。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Sub-agentsは複雑なタスクを専門AIエージェントに分割し、並列実行することで2.6倍の高速化を実現します。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🏗️ アーキテクチャ",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "Task Input",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "Task Decomposition (Planner Agent)",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "Parallel Execution (Specialist Agents)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "Result Integration",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "### 利用可能なエージェント",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Backend Agent**: API、データベース、サーバーサイドロジック",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Frontend Agent**: UI/UX、React、CSS、JavaScript",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database Agent**: スキーマ設計、クエリ最適化、マイグレーション",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Security Agent**: 脆弱性スキャン、認証・認可、安全なコーディング",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **QA Agent**: テスト生成、品質チェック、バグ検出",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 基本使用法",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### 単一エージェント実行",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "# Backend Agentのみ使用",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate backend-agent --scope ./src",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "# Security Agentでコードレビュー",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate security-agent --scope ./src/auth",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "### 並列実行 (2.6x speedup)",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "# 複数エージェントの並列実行",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel backend-agent,frontend-agent,database-agent \\",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "  --scopes ./src/backend,./src/frontend,./src/database",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "# フルスタック開発",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-generator \\",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "  --scopes ./src,./tests",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 パフォーマンス",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "### ベンチマーク結果",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "| タスクタイプ | 単一実行 | 並列実行 | 速度向上 | 品質維持 |",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "|-------------|----------|----------|----------|----------|",

          },
          {
            "text": "| 認証システム実装 | 127.8s | 48.9s | 2.61x | 97.2% |",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "| API開発 | 85.3s | 32.1s | 2.66x | 96.8% |",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "### 品質メトリクス",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
