          {
            "text": "//! Quality Control Agent",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Main QC agent that orchestrates statistical analysis, quantum optimization,",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! mathematical optimization, and visualization to provide comprehensive",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! code quality assessment and improvement suggestions.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Deserialize;",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Serialize;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::collections::HashMap;",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "/// Quality Control Agent configuration",

          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct QcConfig {",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Enable statistical analysis",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub enable_statistical: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Enable quantum optimization",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub enable_quantum: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Enable mathematical optimization",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub enable_mathematical: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Enable visualization",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub enable_visualization: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Output directory for reports and charts",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub output_dir: String,",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Minimum confidence threshold for suggestions",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub min_confidence: f64,",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Enable detailed logging",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub verbose: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "impl Default for QcConfig {",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn default() -&gt; Self {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        Self {",

          },
          {
            "text": "            enable_statistical: true,",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "            enable_quantum: true,",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "            enable_mathematical: true,",

          },
          {
            "text": "            enable_visualization: true,",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "            output_dir: \"qc_reports\".to_string(),",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\guides\\qc-optimizer-orchestration.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 24
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# QC Optimizer サブエージェント &amp; 実装ログ自動化ガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "zapabob/codex の中央集権型 AI オーケストレーションおよび Git worktree 並列開発において、メインマージ直前の品質保証を一貫化するための運用仕様です。",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. QC Optimizer サブエージェントの役割",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "| 項目 | 内容 |",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "| --- | --- |",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "| エージェント名 | &#96;qc-optimizer&#96; |",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "| 主目的 | 単体/ユニット/異常系/包括的テストを実施し、統計・QC 観点でコード品質とアーキテクチャを評価。量子/数理最適化の観点でリスクを最小化し、メインマージ判断を可視化する。 |",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| 主要アウトプット | 1) テストスイート実行結果、2) 問題点の可視化レポート、3) QC/統計/量子最適化の結論、4) &#96;_doc/*.md&#96; に残す実装ログ |",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "| 主なツール | &#96;cargo&#96;, &#96;npm&#96;, &#96;just&#96;, &#96;git&#96;, &#96;scripts/create-implementation-log.js&#96;, Codex MCP ファイル/検索ツール |",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. オーケストレーション手順",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **タスク解析**: Plan/TaskAnalyzer が worktree 単位にタスクを分割し、複雑度 0.7 以上の案件は自動的に &#96;qc-optimizer&#96; を含む並列フローに昇格。",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **開発サブエージェントの作業**: executor/refactorer などがコード変更を行い、PR 前に &#96;qc-optimizer&#96; に制御を移譲。",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **テストマトリクス実行**:",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;cargo test -p &lt;crate&gt;&#96; / &#96;cargo test --all-features&#96;（必要に応じて）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;npm test&#96; / &#96;pnpm test&#96;（GUI, website, prism-web 等）",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;just fmt&#96;/&#96;just fix -p &lt;project&gt;&#96; による Lint 修復",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "   - シナリオ/異常系テスト、snapshot テスト",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **統計・量子最適化評価**:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 失敗率、カバレッジ、実行時間、リソース消費を統計的に評価。",
            "lineNumber": 24
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.47528791427612305
    },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.codex\\skills\\qa-service\\SKILL.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 57
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# QA Service Agent Skill",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "Continuous Quality Assurance service agent that monitors development activities in real-time, automatically triggering quality analysis on code changes. Provides background processing for comprehensive QA validation across parallel development environments, ensuring consistent quality standards throughout the development lifecycle.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Capabilities",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Real-time Monitoring**: File system change detection with intelligent debouncing",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Automatic QA Execution**: Background quality analysis triggered by code modifications",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Multi-worktree Support**: Parallel QA processing across isolated development environments",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Incremental Analysis**: Smart analysis focusing on changed components only",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quality Trend Tracking**: Historical QA metrics and trend analysis",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Integration Status Monitoring**: Continuous validation of merge readiness",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tools Required",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "### MCP Tools",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_read_file&#96; - Reading source files for analysis",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_write_file&#96; - Generating QA reports and metrics",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_codebase_search&#96; - Understanding project structure changes",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;grep&#96; - Pattern matching for file change detection",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;read_file&#96; - File access for change monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;write&#96; - Creating QA artifacts and status files",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### File System Access",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Read**: Full codebase access for monitoring and analysis",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Write**: Limited to &#96;./qa-service-logs&#96;, &#96;./qa-metrics&#96;, &#96;./qa-reports&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### Network Access",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- **None required** - Local file system monitoring only",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### Shell Commands",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- File system monitoring (varies by platform)",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- Process management for service lifecycle",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- Log rotation and cleanup operations",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "## Usage Examples",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "### Start Background QA Monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "codex $qa-service \"Start continuous QA monitoring for development environment\"",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "### Monitor Parallel Development",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "codex $qa-service \"Monitor multiple worktrees with automatic QA validation\"",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "### Quality Trend Analysis",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "codex $qa-service \"Analyze QA trends and generate quality improvement recommendations\"",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "### Service Management",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "codex $qa-service \"Manage QA service lifecycle and configuration\"",
            "lineNumber": 57
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4619044065475464
    },

      "codeBlock": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# QA Integration Guide - Parallel Development with Quality Assurance",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "Complete QA-powered parallel development system that automatically reviews code quality before integration, featuring mathematical optimization analysis, quantum computing principles, and advanced software engineering best practices.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## System Components",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. QA Engineer Skill (&#96;qa-engineer/&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "Advanced QA analysis with:",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Mathematical Optimization**: Algorithmic complexity, Big O analysis",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quantum Optimization**: Quantum circuit efficiency, gate optimization",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Software Engineering**: SOLID principles, clean architecture",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Code Quality**: Readability, maintainability, extensibility metrics",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Git Worktree Manager (&#96;worktree_manager.py&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "Parallel development environment management:",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- Automated worktree creation/deletion",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- Terminal launching for each worktree",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- QA integration and status tracking",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Background QA Service (&#96;background_qa_service.py&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Continuous quality monitoring:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- File system change detection",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- Automatic QA execution",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- Background processing with watchdog",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. Pre-merge QA Hook (&#96;premerge_qa_hook.py&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "Git integration for quality gates:",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- Pre-merge QA validation",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- Merge blocking based on quality criteria",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- Detailed merge reports",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "## Quick Start",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Install QA Components",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "# Install QA skill",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "codex $skill-install https://github.com/zapabob/codex-qa-engineer-skill",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "# Setup worktree manager",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "pip install -e tools/codex-supervisor/",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Create Parallel Development Environment",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "# Create feature worktree with terminal",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "python tools/worktree_manager.py create feature/user-auth auth-feature \"User authentication system\"",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "python tools/worktree_manager.py launch auth-feature",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "# Create another worktree for parallel development",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "python tools/worktree_manager.py create feature/payment payment-feature \"Payment processing\"",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "python tools/worktree_manager.py launch payment-feature",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Start Background QA Monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "# Start background QA service",
            "lineNumber": 58
          }
        ]
      },

          },
          {
            "text": "## &#96;/Plan on|off&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Toggle plan mode on/off.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### Syntax",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan off",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### Behavior",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ON**: Enters plan mode, all operations become read-only until approved",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **OFF**: Exits plan mode, returns to normal operation",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "### Examples",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "# Enable plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "# Disable plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan off",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "## &#96;/Plan \"&lt;title&gt;\" [options]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "Create a new Plan.",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "### Syntax",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan \"&lt;title or goal&gt;\" [--mode=&lt;mode&gt;] [--budget.tokens=&lt;N&gt;] [--budget.time=&lt;minutes&gt;]",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### Parameters",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "|-----------|------|---------|-------------|",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;title&#96; | string | Required | Plan title or goal |",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--mode&#96; | enum | orchestrated | Execution mode: single, orchestrated, competition |",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--budget.tokens&#96; | number | 100000 | Session token cap |",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--budget.time&#96; | number | 30 | Time cap in minutes |",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "### Examples",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "# Minimal (use defaults)",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add request logging\"",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "# With mode",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Refactor auth\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },

          {
            "text": "    /**",

          },
          {
            "text": "     * Create a new Plan",

            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "     */",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    private async createPlan(args: any): Promise&lt;void&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        try {",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "            const title = args?.title || await vscode.window.showInputBox({",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "                prompt: 'Enter Plan title',",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "                placeHolder: 'e.g., Add telemetry feature'",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "            });",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "            if (!title) {",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "                return;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "            const goal = args?.goal || await vscode.window.showInputBox({",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "                prompt: 'Enter Plan goal',",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "                placeHolder: 'e.g., Measure p50/p95 request latency'",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "            });",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "            if (!goal) {",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "                return;",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "            const mode = args?.mode || 'orchestrated';",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "            const budget = args?.budget || {};",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "            const response = await this.client.request&lt;Types.PlanCreateResponse&gt;('Plan.create', {",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "                title,",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "                goal,",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "                mode,",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "                budget",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "            });",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "            ",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "            if (response.success) {",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "                vscode.window.showInformationMessage(",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "                    &#96;✅ Plan created: ${response.Plan_id}&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "                );",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "                ",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "                // Load the new Plan",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "                await this.loadPlan(response.Plan_id);",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "        } catch (error) {",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "            vscode.window.showErrorMessage(&#96;❌ Failed to create Plan: ${error}&#96;);",
            "lineNumber": 101

            "lineNumber": 102
          },

            "text": "    }",

          {
            "lineNumber": 100

          {
            "text": "## ✅ 証明: このガイドで実際に動く",

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "## Slash Commands",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;/Plan on|off&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "Toggle plan mode.",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan on   # Enter plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan off  # Exit plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;/Plan \"&lt;title&gt;\" [options]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "Create a new Plan.",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "**Options**:",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;--mode=single|orchestrated|competition&#96; (default: orchestrated)",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;--budget.tokens=&lt;number&gt;&#96; (default: 100000)",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;--budget.time=&lt;minutes&gt;&#96; (default: 30)",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "**Examples**:",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "# Simple feature",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add logging middleware\" --mode=single",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "# Orchestrated refactor",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Refactor auth system\" --mode=orchestrated --budget.tokens=150000",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "# Performance competition",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Optimize DB query\" --mode=competition",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;/approve &lt;bp-id&gt;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "Approve a Plan for execution.",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /approve bp-2025-11-02T12:00:00Z_add-logging",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;/reject &lt;bp-id&gt; --reason=\"...\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "Reject a Plan with reason.",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /reject bp-123 --reason=\"Scope too broad, split into smaller tasks\"",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;/Plan export &lt;bp-id&gt; [options]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "Export Plan to file.",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "**Options**:",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;--format=md|json|both&#96; (default: both)",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;--path=&lt;directory&gt;&#96; (default: docs/Plans)",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "**Examples**:",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "# Export both formats",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan export bp-123",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "# Markdown only",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan export bp-123 --format=md",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "# Custom path",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan export bp-123 --path=./my-Plans",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;/mode &lt;single|orchestrated|competition&gt;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "Set execution mode.",

          },

          },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Plan Mode Quickstart - 5分で再現可能",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status**: Stable | **Proof**: このガイド通りに動く",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 5分で試せるPlan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan Modeは**タスクを計画→承認→実行**の3段階で安全にAI開発を進める機能です。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 1: インストール確認 (30秒)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install -g @zapabob/codex",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --version",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "# codex-cli 2.8.3",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 2: Plan Mode有効化 (30秒)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "# Plan mode enabled",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 3: 簡単なタスク計画 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add a simple logging function to utils.js\"",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 4: 計画内容を確認 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan export bp-123 --format=md",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "# docs/Plans/bp-123.md が生成される",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 5: 承認して実行 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /approve bp-123",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "codex execute bp-123",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 6: 結果確認 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "# utils.js に logging 関数が追加されているはず",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "cat utils.js",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 動作原理",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "**Plan Modeの3段階フロー**:",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Planning**: AIがタスクを分析・計画（副作用なし）",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Approval**: 人間が計画を承認（安全ゲート）",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Execution**: 承認済み計画を実行（実際の変更）",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "**安全保障**:",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- 承認前はファイル変更なし",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- 予算超過で自動停止",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- 構造化ログで監査可能",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 応用パターン",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "### 並列サブエージェント使用",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Implement user authentication with tests\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "### パフォーマンス競争実行",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Optimize slow database query\" --mode=competition",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "### リサーチ統合",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add React error boundaries\" --research-depth=2",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89

          {

            "text": "/**",

            "text": " */",
            "lineNumber": 62

            "lineNumber": 63,

          },
          {
            "text": "  const {",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "    mode = 'orchestrated',",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "    budget_tokens = 100000,",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "    budget_time = 30,",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "  } = data",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "  const { stdout } = await execAsync(",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "    &#96;codex Plan create \"${title}\" --mode=${mode} --budget-tokens=${budget_tokens} --budget-time=${budget_time} --json&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "  )",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "  return JSON.parse(stdout)",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 76,

          },

            "lineNumber": 77
          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\plan\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 188
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 280
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### &#96;/deepresearch \"&lt;query&gt;\" [options]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "Conduct deep research (requires approval).",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "**Options**:",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;--depth=1|2|3&#96; (default: 2)",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;--policy=focused|comprehensive|exploratory&#96; (default: focused)",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "**Examples**:",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "# Quick research",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /deepresearch \"React Server Components best practices\"",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "# Deep dive",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /deepresearch \"Rust async error handling\" --depth=3 --policy=comprehensive",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "## GUI Controls",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "### Status Bar",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Inactive**: \"$(edit) Enter plan mode\"",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Drafting**: \"$(edit) Plan: drafting\"",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Pending**: \"$(clock) Plan: pending\" (amber background)",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Approved**: \"$(check) Plan: approved\" (green)",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Rejected**: \"$(x) Plan: rejected\" (red background)",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "Click to toggle plan mode.",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "### Toolbar Buttons",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "Located in Plan panel:",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Enter Plan** - Toggle mode",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Approve** - Approve current Plan",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Reject** - Reject with reason",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Export** - Export MD/JSON",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Mode Selector** - Switch execution strategy",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "### Keybindings",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Shift+Tab&#96; - Toggle plan mode (editorTextFocus)",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Ctrl+Shift+D&#96; - Delegate task to agent",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Ctrl+Shift+R&#96; - Deep research",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Ctrl+Shift+C&#96; - Review selected code",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "## Execution Modes",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "### Single Mode",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "**Use Case**: Simple, single-file changes",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "**Behavior**:",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "- No sub-agents",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "- Single LLM context",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "- Fast execution",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "**Example**:",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add docstring to function\" --mode=single",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "### Orchestrated Mode (Default)",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "**Use Case**: Complex, multi-file changes requiring coordination",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "**Behavior**:",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "- Central planner generates task DAG",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "- Specialist sub-agents (Backend/Frontend/DB/Security/QA)",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "- Integrator merges deterministic diffs",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "- Tests/linters run before PR",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "**Example**:",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Refactor auth system to JWT\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "**Agents Used**:",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "- Backend Agent: Core logic",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "- Database Agent: Schema changes",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "- Security Agent: Vulnerability review",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "- QA Agent: Test generation",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "### Competition Mode",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "**Use Case**: Performance optimization, algorithm selection",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "**Behavior**:",
            "lineNumber": 280
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3561060428619385
    },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    pub name: String,",

          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct WorktreeManager {",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    repo_path: PathBuf,",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    worktree_base: PathBuf,",

          },

          },

            "text": "impl WorktreeManager {",

          },
          {
            "text": "    pub fn new(repo_path: impl AsRef&lt;Path&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "        // Create worktree base directory if it doesn't exist",

          },
          {
            "text": "        if !worktree_base.exists() {",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "/// Git worktree management for concurrent editing",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "///",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Enables multiple Codex instances to work on different branches simultaneously",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "/// using Git worktrees. Each instance gets its own working directory linked to",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "/// a unique branch, avoiding file conflicts.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "use crate::errors::GitToolingError;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "use anyhow::Context;",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "use anyhow::Result;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::path::Path;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::path::PathBuf;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::process::Command;",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Git worktree information",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone)]",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct Worktree {",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Path to the worktree directory",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub path: PathBuf,",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Branch name (e.g., \"codex-agent-123\")",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub branch: String,",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Base commit SHA",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub base_commit: String,",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Worktree configuration",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone)]",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct WorktreeConfig {",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Repository root path",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub repo_root: PathBuf,",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Worktree prefix (e.g., \"codex-agent\")",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub worktree_prefix: String,",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Instance ID (e.g., agent ID, session ID)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub instance_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },

          },

          {

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "                return None",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "            # Create worktree path",

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "                return None",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "            # Create worktree info",

          },

          },
          {

          },

          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    # Ensure worktrees directory exists",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (!(Test-Path $WorktreeRoot)) {",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $WorktreeRoot | Out-Null",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "    $worktreePath = Join-Path $WorktreeRoot $BranchName",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "    # Check if worktree already exists",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (Test-Path $worktreePath) {",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "        Write-Warning \"Worktree already exists at: $worktreePath\"",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "        if ($Force) {",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "            Write-Host \"Force removing existing worktree...\"",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "            git worktree remove $worktreePath --force 2&gt;$null",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $worktreePath 2&gt;$null",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "        } else {",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "            return",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "    try {",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Create worktree",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "        git worktree add $worktreePath $Base",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Create and checkout branch if different from base",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "        if ($BranchName -ne $Base) {",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "            Push-Location $worktreePath",
            "lineNumber": 94

            "text": "- **問題**: &#96;canonicalize()&#96;は使用されているが、ベースディレクトリ制限がない",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;validate_path_against_base()&#96;関数を追加",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 許可されたベースディレクトリ（codex_dir、cwd、home）内のみアクセス可能に制限",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;fs.read&#96;と&#96;fs.write&#96;メソッドでパス検証を実装",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. バイナリ配布の改ざんリスク対策 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "#### install-binary.js",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **問題**: SHA256検証が実装されているが使用されていない、リダイレクト検証が不十分",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  - SHA256チェックサムファイル（&#96;.sha256&#96;）のダウンロードと検証を実装",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  - リダイレクト回数の制限（MAX_REDIRECTS = 5）を追加",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  - ホスト名検証（github.com、githubusercontent.comのみ許可）を追加",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;rejectUnauthorized: true&#96;で自己署名証明書を拒否",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. 認証・認可の不備チェックと修正 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "#### orchestrator/src/server.rs",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- **問題**: RPCメソッドに認証チェックがない",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;requires_auth()&#96;関数を追加（読み取り専用メソッドを除くすべてのメソッドで認証を要求）",
            "lineNumber": 47
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.44824814796447754

        "range": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 攻撃者視点セキュリティ脆弱性監査と改善実装完了（最終版）",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 実装日時",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "2025-12-30 17:44:12",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 実装内容",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. コマンドインジェクション脆弱性の修正 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "#### install-binary.js",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **問題**: &#96;exec()&#96;で文字列連結を使用し、パスに特殊文字が含まれるとコマンドインジェクションが可能",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;exec()&#96;を&#96;spawn()&#96;に変更し、引数を配列で渡すように修正",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  - パス検証関数&#96;validatePath()&#96;を追加（nullバイト、コマンド区切り文字などを拒否）",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "  - PowerShellコマンドをパラメータ化された形式に変更（変数に代入してから使用）",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;7z&#96;コマンドの&#96;-o&#96;オプションを文字列連結から&#96;+&#96;演算子に変更",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "#### user_shell.rs",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- **問題**: &#96;!cmd&#96;経由のユーザーコマンド実行に検証が不足",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;command_might_be_dangerous()&#96;を使用して危険なコマンドをブロック",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;rm -rf&#96;、&#96;sudo&#96;、破壊的なgit操作などを事前に検出して拒否",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. パストラバーサル脆弱性の修正 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "#### orchestrator/src/server.rs",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **問題**: &#96;canonicalize()&#96;は使用されているが、ベースディレクトリ制限がない",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;validate_path_against_base()&#96;関数を追加",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 許可されたベースディレクトリ（codex_dir、cwd、home）内のみアクセス可能に制限",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;fs.read&#96;と&#96;fs.write&#96;メソッドでパス検証を実装",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. バイナリ配布の改ざんリスク対策 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "#### install-binary.js",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- **問題**: SHA256検証が実装されているが使用されていない、リダイレクト検証が不十分",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  - SHA256チェックサムファイル（&#96;.sha256&#96;）のダウンロードと検証を実装",
            "lineNumber": 38
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.42918556928634644

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\2025-01-02_セキュリティ脆弱性改善とバグフィクス{main}.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 38,
            "column": 2
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# セキュリティ脆弱性改善とバグフィクス実装完了",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 実装日時",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "2025-01-02",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 実装内容",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. エラーハンドリングの問題修正 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "#### rate_limit.rsの修正",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **問題**: &#96;SystemTime::duration_since()&#96;の結果を&#96;unwrap()&#96;で処理していたため、システムクロックが後ろに戻った場合（NTP調整など）にpanicする可能性",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;SystemTime::duration_since()&#96;のエラーハンドリングを追加",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  - システムクロックの後退を検出して適切に処理（エントリをリセット）",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;check_with_config()&#96;と&#96;remaining()&#96;メソッドの両方でエラーハンドリングを実装",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "  - エラー時はレート制限を緩和（エントリをリセットして新しいリクエストを許可）",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "#### secret_masking.rsの修正",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- **問題**: 正規表現のコンパイルで&#96;unwrap()&#96;を使用していたため、正規表現パターンが不正な場合にpanicする可能性",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;once_cell::Lazy&#96;を使用して正規表現を一度だけコンパイル",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 正規表現のコンパイルエラーを適切に処理（エラー時はマスキングをスキップ）",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  - エラーログを一度だけ記録する機能を追加",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  - すべての正規表現パターン（OpenAI APIキー、GitHubトークン、Google APIキー、Bearerトークン、パスワード、URL認証情報）でエラーハンドリングを実装",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "#### util.rsの修正",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **問題**: &#96;error_or_panic()&#96;関数でデバッグモード時に&#96;panic!&#96;を使用していたため、開発環境での予期しないクラッシュが発生する可能性",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **修正**:",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;panic!&#96;を削除し、エラーログのみを出力するように変更",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  - デバッグモードでもpanicせず、エラーログを出力するように改善",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 依存関係の脆弱性スキャンと修正 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "#### cargo auditの実行",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **結果**: 脆弱性は検出されませんでした（882 crate dependenciesをスキャン）",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "#### npm auditの実行と修正",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- **検出された脆弱性**: 7件",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 39
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.42516863346099854
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\PR_DESCRIPTION.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
