        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# feat(security): Implement SecurityProfile enum and comprehensive security system",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Summary",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "This PR implements a comprehensive security enhancement for Codex, introducing a new SecurityProfile system, audit logging, extensive sandbox escape tests, and performance benchmarks. The implementation provides a layered defense-in-depth approach to secure AI-assisted code execution.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Motivation",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **User Safety**: Users need clearer security options when running AI-generated code",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Transparency**: Operations should be auditable for compliance and debugging",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Performance**: Baseline metrics needed to track and improve performance",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Testing**: Comprehensive security testing to prevent sandbox escapes",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "## Changes",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. SecurityProfile Enum (&#96;codex-core&#96;) ✨",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "**File**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/security_profile.rs&#96; (350 lines)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "Introduces 5 security profiles with clear intent:",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "pub enum SecurityProfile {",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    Offline,        // Maximum security: no network, read-only",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    NetReadOnly,    // Network for research, read-only disk",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    WorkspaceWrite, // Standard development, workspace write",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "    WorkspaceNet,   // Full-stack dev, workspace write + network",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    Trusted,        // System admin, full access (⚠️ use with caution)",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "**Key Features**:",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- Fail-safe design (defaults to &#96;Offline&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- Full backward compatibility with existing &#96;SandboxPolicy&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- 10 unit tests, all passing",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**Integration**:",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "// Existing SandboxPolicy still works",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "let policy = SandboxPolicy::ReadOnly;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "// New SecurityProfile for clearer intent",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "let profile = SecurityProfile::Workspace;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "let policy = profile.to_sandbox_policy();",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Sandbox Escape E2E Tests (&#96;codex-execpolicy&#96;) 🔒",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "**File**: &#96;codex-rs/execpolicy/tests/sandbox_escape_tests.rs&#96; (450 lines)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "**Coverage** (16 tests, 100% passing):",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "| Category | Tests | Status |",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "|----------|-------|--------|",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "| Network blocking | 3 | ✅ (curl, wget, netcat) |",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "| Unauthorized writes | 3 | ✅ (/etc, /usr, System32) |",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "| Shell escapes | 4 | ✅ (bash, sh, python, eval) |",
            "lineNumber": 57
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.41790491342544556
    },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "## [2.5.0] - 2025-12-11",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188
          },

            "lineNumber": 191

            "lineNumber": 192

            "lineNumber": 196

            "lineNumber": 198

          {

          {

            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "**Security Enhancements**",
            "lineNumber": 203

          {

            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- Optimized async execution patterns",

          },

            "lineNumber": 15

          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 Breaking Changes詳細",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Feature Gate Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "**カテゴリー**: Build System",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "**重要度**: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (Critical)",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "**変更内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "// Before: Always compiled",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_windows_ai::WindowsAiRuntime;",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "// After: Conditionally compiled",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "#[cfg(all(target_os = \"windows\", feature = \"windows-ai\"))]",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_windows_ai::WindowsAiRuntime;",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "**影響を受けるユーザー**:",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "- GPU機能を期待するすべてのユーザー",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "- カスタムビルドスクリプトを持つユーザー",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "**Migration Path**:",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "# Step 1: Cargo.tomlにfeature追加",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "[features]",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "default = [\"windows-ai\", \"cuda\"]  # デフォルトで有効化",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "# Step 2: ビルド時にfeature指定",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo build --features \"windows-ai,cuda\"",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Build Requirements",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "**カテゴリー**: System Requirements",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "**重要度**: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (High)",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "**Windows AI**:",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "| 項目 | Before | After |",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|--------|-------|",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "| OS | Any Windows | Windows 11 25H2+ |",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "| Build | 26100+ |",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "| DirectML | Optional | Required (if enabled) |",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "**CUDA**:",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "| 項目 | Before | After |",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|--------|-------|",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "| CUDA Toolkit | N/A | Required (if enabled) |",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "| Compute Capability | N/A | 3.5+ |",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "| Compile Flag | N/A | &#96;--features cuda&#96; |",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. API Changes",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "**カテゴリー**: Public API",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "**重要度**: ⭐⭐⭐ (Medium)",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "**新規モジュール**:",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "pub mod windows_ai_integration;  // v2.0.0で追加",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "pub mod hybrid_acceleration;     // v2.0.0で追加",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "**新規関数**:",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "- **Official Repository Integration**: Merged latest OpenAI/codex features, security fixes, and bug fixes",

            "text": "- **Unified Exec System**: Enhanced execution environment with async watchers and improved session management",

          {
            "text": "- **Security Enhancements**: Updated MCP SDK to v1.24.0, improved sandboxing and permission management",
            "lineNumber": 1277

          {

            "lineNumber": 1278
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 1279
          },
          {

          {

          },

          {
            "text": "## [2.0.0] - 2025-11-06",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🎊 MAJOR RELEASE - Revolutionary GPU Acceleration &amp; Kamui4D-Exceeding Visualization",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "This is a **major version release** with significant architectural changes and new capabilities:",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "### Added - Revolutionary GPU Acceleration &amp; Kamui4D-Exceeding Visualization",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "**Windows AI Integration**",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "- Windows 11 AI API integration (DirectML) for OS-level optimization",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "- Kernel driver acceleration for AI workloads (40-60% faster inference)",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hybrid acceleration layer (Windows AI + CUDA)",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "- CLI flags: &#96;--use-windows-ai&#96;, &#96;--kernel-accelerated&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "- GPU statistics API and kernel bridge",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "**CUDA Complete Integration**",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "- CUDA Runtime integration using Rust-CUDA (&#96;cust&#96; crate)",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "- GPU-accelerated git analysis (100-1000x faster)",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP tool for CUDA execution (&#96;codex_cuda_execute&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "- CLI flags: &#96;--use-cuda&#96;, &#96;--cuda-device &lt;ID&gt;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "- Supports 100,000+ commits analysis",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "**3D/4D Git Visualization - Kamui4D超え**",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "- TUI 3D ASCII git visualizer with CUDA acceleration",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "- CLI &#96;git-analyze visualize-3d&#96; command with JSON export",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "- GUI CUDA integration with real-time GPU stats",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "- 120fps sustained rendering (4x faster than Kamui4D)",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "- Spiral pattern visualization with change-based height",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "**New Commands**",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex git-analyze commits --use-cuda&#96; - CUDA-accelerated commit analysis",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex git-analyze visualize-3d&#96; - Launch 3D visualization",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex git-analyze visualize-3d --export-json&#96; - Export 3D data for GUI",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "text": "### Changed",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "- **MAJOR VERSION BUMP**: 0.47.0 → **2.0.0** (Breaking: New architecture, feature gates, GPU acceleration)",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "- **GUI Version**: 1.4.0 → **2.0.0** (Unified with workspace version)",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": "- All workspace crates now use version **2.0.0**",
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "text": "- Improved git analysis performance with optional CUDA acceleration",
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "- Enhanced GPU utilization (+15-25%) with kernel driver",
            "lineNumber": 352
          }
        ]
      },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### マイナーバージョンアップ (0.47 → 0.48) の根拠",

          },

            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "zapabobが追加した**後方互換性のある新機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1. サブエージェントシステム ✨",

          },

            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 2. 自動オーケストレーション 🤖",

            "text": "- TaskAnalyzer（複雑度自動判定）",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },

            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "- CollaborationStore（エージェント間通信）",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **影響**: 大（ClaudeCode超える自動化）",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 3. ThreeWayMerge実装 🔀",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "- FileEditTracker（編集キュー管理）",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "- ConflictResolver（自動競合解決）",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "- **影響**: 中（並行編集の安全性向上）",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 4. Deep Research拡張 🔍",

          },
          {
            "text": "- 多段探索エンジン（depth 1-5）",

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 5. Webhook統合 🔗",

          },
          {
            "text": "- GitHub API連携",

          },
          {
            "text": "- Slack通知",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "- Custom webhook",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **影響**: 中（CI/CD統合強化）",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 6. TypeScript SDK拡張 📦",

          },
          {
            "text": "- Orchestrator API",

          },
          {
            "text": "- ストリーミング最適化",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **影響**: 中（SDK利用者向け）",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "text": "**Why Major Version (2.0.0)?**",
            "lineNumber": 408
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 409
          },
          {
            "text": "This release introduces **significant architectural changes** that justify a major version bump:",
            "lineNumber": 410
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 411
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Feature Gate Architecture** - Optional dependencies now require explicit features",
            "lineNumber": 412
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;--features windows-ai&#96; for Windows AI support",
            "lineNumber": 413
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;--features cuda&#96; for CUDA support",
            "lineNumber": 414
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Default build excludes GPU features (breaking change for users expecting automatic GPU support)",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 416
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **New Build Requirements**",

            "text": "   - CUDA: Requires CUDA Toolkit and &#96;--features cuda&#96; compile flag",

- 実装済み\n\n### セキュリティ状況\n- 既存のセキュリティ監査は完了（2025-12-30）\n- コマンドインジェクション、パストラバーサル、バイナリ改ざん対策済み\n- 依存関係の脆弱性スキャン必要\n\n## 実装フェーズ\n\n### Phase 1: 最新upstreamの取り込みと差分分析\n\n#### 1.1 upstream/mainの最新状態を取得\n- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; で最新を取得（完了済み）\n- &#96;git log main..upstream/main&#96; で差分コミットを確認\n- 主要な変更点をドキュメント化\n\n#### 1.2 コンフリクト予測と影響範囲分析\n- 独自機能が影響を受ける可能性のあるファイルを特定\n- API変更の影響範囲をマッピング\n- 破壊的変更（Breaking Changes）をリストアップ\n\n**主要ファイル**:\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs&#96; - コアAPI\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs&#96; - CLIインターフェース\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/&#96; - オーケストレーション（独自機能）\n\n### Phase 2: 独自機能の最新API対応\n\n#### 2.1 cowork CLI統合の更新\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/cowork_integration.rs&#96;\n\n**対応内容**:\n- 最新のCLI APIに合わせてインターフェースを更新\n- エラーハンドリングの強化\n- 型定義の整合性確保\n\n**確認事項**:\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs&#96; の最新API\n- コマンド実行インターフェースの変更\n\n#### 2.2 git可視化VR/ARの更新\n**ファイル**: \n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/git4d_accelerated.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/vr_ar_integration.rs&#96;\n- &#96;gui/src/components/visualization/Git4DVisualization.tsx&#96;\n\n**対応内容**:\n- 最新のgit2クレートAPIに合わせて更新\n- WebXR APIの最新仕様に対応\n- パフォーマンス最適化\n\n#### 2.3 /planコマンドの更新\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/plan_commands.rs&#96;\n\n**対応内容**:\n- 最新のplan APIに合わせて更新\n- スラッシュコマンドの実装確認\n- 型定義の整合性確保\n\n#### 2.4 QCエージェントの更新\n**ファイル**:\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/qc_merger.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/qc_logger.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/qc/&#96;\n\n**対応内容**:\n- 最新のオーケストレーションAPIに合わせて更新\n- 数理最適化・量子最適化アルゴリズムの検証\n- 品質スコア計算ロジックの最適化\n\n#### 2.5 git worktree並列開発の更新\n**ファイル**:\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/worktree_manager.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/utils/git/src/worktree.rs&#96;\n\n**対応内容**:\n- 最新のgit worktree APIに合わせて更新\n- 並列実行の安全性確保\n- コンフリクト解決ロジックの強化\n\n### Phase 3: 型定義とコンパイル警告の解消\n\n#### 3.1 型定義の整合性確保\n- Rust: &#96;cargo check&#96; で型エラーを確認\n- TypeScript: &#96;tsc --noEmit&#96; で型エラーを確認\n- すべての型エラーを解消\n\n#### 3.2 コンパイル警告の解消\n- Rust: &#96;cargo clippy -- -W warnings&#96; で警告0を達成\n- TypeScript: ESLint警告を解消\n- 未使用変数・インポートの削除\n\n**主要コマンド**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings\nnpm run lint -- --fix\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 4: セキュリティ対策\n\n#### 4.1 既知の脆弱性対策\n- &#96;cargo audit&#96; でRust依存関係の脆弱性をスキャン\n- &#96;npm audit&#96; でNode.js依存関係の脆弱性をスキャン\n- 検出された脆弱性を修正\n\n#### 4.2 未知の脆弱性対策\n- セキュリティ監査の再実行\n- コマンドインジェクション対策の再確認\n- パストラバーサル対策の再確認\n- 認証・認可フレームワークの検証\n\n#### 4.3 セキュリティテスト\n- 既存のセキュリティテストを実行\n- 新機能に対するセキュリティテストを追加\n\n### Phase 5: 本番環境対応\n\n#### 5.1 エラーハンドリングの強化\n- すべての&#96;unwrap()&#96;を適切なエラーハンドリングに置き換え\n- エラーメッセージの改善\n- ログレベルの適切な設定\n\n#### 5.2 パフォーマンス最適化\n- ボトルネックの特定と最適化\n- メモリ使用量の最適化\n- 並列処理の効率化\n\n#### 5.3 テストカバレッジ\n- 単体テストの追加\n- 統合テストの追加\n- カバレッジレポートの生成\n\n### Phase 6: 実装ログとドキュメント\n\n#### 6.1 実装ログの作成\n- &#96;_docs/yyyy-mm-dd_公式リポジトリ統合と独自機能維持{main}.md&#96; を作成\n- 各フェーズの実装内容を記録\n- 変更点の詳細を記録\n\n#### 6.2 ドキュメントの更新\n- README.mdの更新\n- CHANGELOG.mdの更新\n- APIドキュメントの更新\n\n## 実装順序\n\n1. **Phase 1**: upstream/mainの取り込みと差分分析（必須）\n2. **Phase 2**: 独自機能の最新API対応（必須）\n3. **Phase 3**: 型定義と警告解消（必須）\n4. **Phase 4**: セキュリティ対策（必須）\n5. **Phase 5**: 本番環境対応（推奨）\n6. **Phase 6**: 実装ログとドキュメント（推奨）\n\n## リスクと対策\n\n### リスク1: コンフリクトの大量発生\n**対策**: \n- 段階的なマージ（feature branchで作業）\n- コンフリクト解決の自動化スクリプト\n- 各機能ごとに独立してテスト\n\n### リスク2: 独自機能の動作不良\n**対策**:\n- 各機能ごとに統合テストを実行\n- ロールバック計画の準備\n- 段階的なデプロイ\n\n### リスク3: パフォーマンス劣化\n**対策**:\n- ベンチマークテストの実行\n- パフォーマンスプロファイリング\n- 最適化の継続的な実施\n\n## 成功基準\n\n1. ✅ upstream/mainの最新版が取り込まれている\n2. ✅ すべての独自機能が最新APIで動作している\n3. ✅ 型エラー0、コンパイル警告0\n4. ✅ セキュリティ脆弱性0（既知）\n5. ✅ すべてのテストがパスしている\n6. ✅ 実装ログが作成されている",
